into multiple shards that ricochet to nearby enemies. Knockbacks on hit
Has an unmodifiable cooldown of 4 seconds

skills.name: Buckshot
description: Perform a brutal, short range attack that deals very high damage to close enemies
Each fragment splits into two additional fragments that are flung towards nearby enemies

skills.name: Cloak of Shadows
description: cast a shadow to blind nearby enemies lowering their
defenses and physical resist for a period of time

skills.name: Cold Damage Aura

skills.name: Cold Enchant

Gains synergy damage bonus from all elemental tree damage spells

skills.name: Death Ritual

skills.name: Delayed Teleport

description: Alternate attuning from one element to another, granting different

Chain Lightning damage: 100% weapon damage as lightning

skills.name: Eagle Eye

Can be toggled on and off
lines: Does not stack with Assassin's Disciplines

description: creates a magical shield that consumes mana
instead of health when you take damage
Every 10% of the lowest elemental resist lowers the

lowering their resists against elemental damage

synergies.name: Pierce Flesh & Bone

You have a 10% chance to release two times more charged bolts

You also gain poison pierce for the duration

Scorch can use up to 6 firestarter stacks
Firestarter duration: 6 seconds

skills.name: Shadow Dance
description: Sneak up on the target enemy, stunning all nearby enemies

skills.name: Weaken

before shattering them into frozen bits.
lines: Requires elemental form to be cast

skills.name: Widowmaker

skills.name: Winged Embrace
